scientific_integrity: Analytical proof by renewal-gap encoding, a two-state transfer determinant, a word-count radius sandwich, and a uniform derivative argument; finite computations are corroborative only. Dillon's general graph entropy theorem is explicitly credited for the transfer-entropy framework.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers infinite gap sets and one-marker centered forbidden words with both thresholds above the smallest allowed gap. No claim for arbitrary multi-marker words, nor an independent bibliographic audit.
title: A sharp two-threshold renewal-tail law for centered holes in gap shifts
